key_insight: UniGRPO introduces a unified reinforcement learning framework that jointly optimizes reasoning (prompt expansion) and image synthesis for interleaved generation, enabling a single policy to coordinate text-based reasoning and flow-matching image modules.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between separately trained text-reasoning and image-generation components by providing a trainable, decision-making framework for interleaved multimodal generation—specifically tackling how to coordinate prompt expansion and subsequent image synthesis within one loop.
method: Formulate a single-round interleaved generation task as an RL problem where actions include reasoning (expanding the prompt) and invoking image-generation modules.
Train a unified policy that interfaces autoregressive text modeling for reasoning and flow-matching image generators, using reward signals that reflect reasoning quality and visual fidelity.
Validate the approach on a reasoning-driven image generation setup (prompt expansion → image synthesis) to demonstrate feasibility of joint optimization and coordination.
impact: Provides a practical framework for building end-to-end systems that plan and generate multimodal outputs cohesively, simplifying pipeline design and enabling more coherent, reasoning-informed image generation workflows.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: user prompt → reasoning (text expansion) → image generator, annotated as sequential RL actions
Architecture sketch: unified policy interfacing autoregressive text and flow-matching image modules
Reward schematic: example signals for reasoning correctness and image fidelity feeding back to the policy
Before/after examples: original prompt vs expanded prompt and resulting generated image to show the effect of reasoning
paper_title: UniGRPO: Unified Policy Optimization for Reasoning-Driven Visual Generation
paper_authors: Jie Liu, Zilyu Ye, Linxiao Yuan, Shenhan Zhu, Yu Gao
